name: @spacemansh/anti-slop
description: Opinionated Oxlint rules that reject low-evidence TypeScript and JavaScript patterns.
author: Tony Edgal (https://github.com/tonyedgal)

scripts.lint:packaging: oxlint --config packaging/oxlint.config.ts packaging scripts/check-package.mjs scripts/check-changeset.mjs scripts/check-release.test.mjs scripts/publish-package.mjs tsdown.config.ts
scripts.fmt:packaging: oxfmt packaging scripts/check-package.mjs scripts/check-changeset.mjs scripts/check-release.test.mjs scripts/publish-package.mjs tsdown.config.ts tsconfig.build.json tsconfig.packaging.json package.json .changeset .github/workflows
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm typecheck && pnpm check:skill-assets
